$comment: Every social video is declared here. Add an entry, run `node build.mjs`, get a video. Copy lives in this file, not in code or hand-written SVG. Cards render as HTML through Chrome, so long headlines wrap and shrink instead of running off the frame.
$safeAreas: Platform chrome covers the top 180px, bottom 320px, and rightmost 120px. The card layout keeps all copy inside those bounds.
$shotQuality: activity.png and connectors.png were captured with nothing connected — they read 'No connectors yet' / 'No connectors online'. Do NOT use them under copy that claims Rabta is connected to your tools; the screenshot contradicts the words. Strong shots: restore, overview, projects. Mixed: capsules (good list, empty detail pane). Recapture activity/connectors in a connected state to unlock them.
$audio: Background bed mixed onto every video. `lufs` is the loudness target — LOWER IS QUIETER. Typical music masters near -14; -22 sits clearly underneath. Set a video's "audio": false to keep it silent, or give it its own {file, lufs}. Drop any royalty-free track into audio/ and point `file` at it. NOTE: a TikTok Business Account may only use TikTok's Commercial Sounds Library — burned-in music can get the post muted. This bed is synthesised in-house (no rights attached), so it is safe, but adding sound in-app is still the better route on TikTok.

videos.$note: Carousels output a folder of 1080x1920 PNGs, not a video. Post as a TikTok photo post or an Instagram carousel. TikTok requires 4-35 slides; completion rate is ranked, so few strong slides beat many weak ones. Slide 1 is the cover — it has to work as a still.
